Requirements: R-15
Plan row: TS-9

Obligation: OB-9

## Given
- The seeded verified user U signed in in a cookie jar with an empty cart (cleared first through DELETE of its own rows). Own books B1 and B2 (stock 5).

## When
1. P-empty: POST the checkout quote endpoint with the empty cart.
2. Add B1 x2 and B2 x1 via POST /api/cart; POST the quote endpoint (P-quote).
3. Lower B1 stock below 2 through the test seed endpoint, POST the quote endpoint (P-overstock).
4. Restore stock, POST the order endpoint with the mock card (P-order).
5. GET /api/cart as U.

## Then
1. P-empty: the quote is rejected (4xx, with error and code), no quote is issued.
2. P-quote: the quote lists B1 x2 and B2 x1 (items and quantities read from the quote body match the cart read from GET /api/cart).
3. P-overstock: the quote is rejected (4xx) for the quantity above stock.
4. P-order: the order succeeds (2xx) with items B1 x2 and B2 x1.
5. After the order GET /api/cart as U has no row for B1 or B2 (cart cleared).

## Self-probe notes
- The quote content is compared with the cart read through GET /api/cart, not computed from the quote itself; no price is hard-coded.
- Rejection status classes only: exact codes are not given by a requirement (Q1). Payment itself is out of scope.
- The exact quote and order endpoint paths and body come from the openapi spec (spec.ts:576); the automator binds them at S5.
